description: Updates the overall status of an accession.

body.status: enum, required - PENDING | PARTIALLY_COLLECTED | COLLECTED | PROCESSING | COMPLETED | CANCELLED

validation: accession must exist and belong to organization + branch
status must be one of PENDING, PARTIALLY_COLLECTED, COLLECTED, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED (CHECK)

errors.condition: status missing or not a recognized enum value
accession not found / not in organization+branch scope

constraints: status CHECK IN (PENDING, PARTIALLY_COLLECTED, COLLECTED, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED)

notes: No CHECK constraint or state-machine enforces which status transitions are valid (e.g. whether CANCELLED can move back to PENDING) - the database accepts any value from the fixed enum list regardless of the current status. Only the value-set is enforced, not the transition sequence.
